title: 企业简洁
referenceRole: actual Showcase component screenshot; style reference only
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE new high-fidelity desktop Chinese B2B component-library visual direction mockup, labeled "E  企业简洁", for Mono Design, using the supplied actual StyleKit Corporate Clean component screenshot as a STYLE REFERENCE.
Reference role: Image 1 supplies the design language of comfortable rounded controls, subtle light shadows, slate neutral colors, blue action hierarchy and readable typography. Adapt that language to the resource-management application below. Do not reproduce its landing page, brand, marketing copy, metrics or claims. No prior generated image is an edit target.

Canvas: crisp flat front-facing landscape desktop UI specimen, approximately 1600x1100 composition, high-resolution legible Chinese. No device frame, perspective or outside scene. Top narrow specimen banner reads "E  企业简洁" and "MONO DESIGN / CORPORATE CLEAN". Main resource-management app occupies upper 70%; lower 25% is a coherent component-state specimen strip. Same business structure as a comparison study: left navigation, toolbar, organization tree, four-row selectable data table, right new-resource form, lower buttons/inputs/selection/date/status specimen. Keep all regions visible and no clipped content.

STYLE: enterprise calm, trustworthy and carefully proportioned. Page ground #F8FAFC, pure-white content surfaces, #0F172A headings, #334155 body and #64748B intentionally muted helper text, #E2E8F0 hairline boundaries, primary buttons #2563EB with white text and deeper #1E40AF supporting brand. Pale #EFF6FF selected backgrounds and blue focus state. Controls consistently 8px-equivalent radius, panels 12px; soft very small neutral shadows on raised panels/buttons, no heavy glow. 8px rhythm, practical 36-40px controls, approximately 48px table rows, balanced breathing room. Chinese system sans-serif (PingFang SC/Noto Sans SC feel), semi-bold 28-30px main title and 14px-equivalent body. Single coherent white work surface, with a framed table/tree region and a separate calm white editing panel. Keep the interface free of card-within-card clutter. No sharp black outlines, no oversized heavy headings, no hot pink, no neon, no gradient buttons or glass effects.

App: white left sidebar with small blue abstract mark plus "Mono" wordmark. Outline icons and nav labels "概览", active "资源管理", "组件规范", "设置". Active nav is a soft light-blue rounded rectangle with blue icon/text; never a black slab. Main title "资源管理", subtitle "管理团队资源与访问状态", solid blue primary action "新增资源". Toolbar contains rounded search "搜索资源", status select "全部状态", calendar range "2026/10/01 — 2026/10/31". Each is recognizable and aligned without blue outlines on every resting field.
Organization tree titled "团队", groups "产品组", "设计组", "工程组"; expanded product group contains "产品文档" and "需求资料".
Table columns "资源名称", "负责人", "状态", "更新时间". Exactly four rows "设计规范 v1", "组件清单", "交付检查", "测试数据", short Chinese owners and October 2026 dates. Checkboxes visible, one row selected with pale-blue background and blue checkbox. Table header very pale slate, dark text, no black fill and no dark blue fill. Quiet horizontal row separators, not a heavy cell grid. Status labels "已启用", "草稿", "已停用" use subtle green/amber/red tinted badges with meaningful icons/dots and darker colored text. Pagination "共 4 条", rounded square active page 1 blue, arrows and page-size select at bottom.

Right form titled "新建资源": labeled "资源名称", "负责人", "资源分类". Rounded outlined inputs with correct error/focus styling. Empty name with red border, a small error icon and helper "请填写资源名称". Owner and category selects have quiet borders. Upload "上传附件" uses a light dashed rounded boundary, upload icon and concise instruction. File item "design-spec.pdf" and "2.4 MB" with removal affordance. Footer outline secondary "取消" and solid blue "保存". Card shadow is extremely restrained and background remains neutral.

Bottom component-state specimen on a white rounded panel: three buttons "主要操作", "次要操作", "不可用"; normal, focused and error inputs. Focused input must have a visible blue focus ring separated from its border by a 2px white gap, no neon glow. Checkbox, radio and switch examples selected/unselected; small October 2026 calendar with blue selected date; semantic statuses labeled success/warning/error with text and symbols. Use a professional differentiated gray hierarchy that remains readable. All controls and section labels within margins. This is a polished real-product interface style, not a marketing poster.
status: comparison candidate; not selected or implemented
